title: Research quality evaluation by AI in the era of Large Language Models: Advantages, disadvantages, and systemic effects

bias_targets.methodology: Summarizing a large-scale empirical study that analyzed LLM-generated research quality scores for 117,650 articles spanning a 20-year period (2003-2023) to detect tendencies of the model to score more recent publications higher.
Summarizing an investigation that compared average ChatGPT quality scores across 26 different Scopus fields to identify structural differences in LLM evaluations based on academic discipline.
Summarizing an analysis that evaluated the correlation between the word count length of research article abstracts and the quality scores assigned by ChatGPT.
